gen-eater-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Dark, gnarled and a bit menacing, Eater is all attitude with solid, readable strokes. Mochiy Pop P One counters with wide gaps between letters and a sizable lowercase, a sans-serif that is all friendliness.
gen-eater-gf-montserrat-underline: Eater's thin strokes and weighty stems sit far apart, giving it a gloomy, spaced-out menace. And Montserrat Underline, a sans with round bowls and oversized lowercase, makes the quieter, steadier partner beneath it.
gen-eater-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline reads big-bodied and friendly, with a splayed terminal on the c that feels modern. Eater growls with dark, spread-out letters at the top, while Mozilla Headline simply gets on with being easy company.
gen-eater-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text looks bold for a sans-serif, since its tall bodies fill the line and its terminals flare outward. Eater supplies the growl above it, with short ascenders and wide gaps, and Mozilla Text keeps the lines below steady and tidy.
gen-eater-gf-nata-sans: Eater carries a dark, aggressive streak, with sturdy hairlines, moderate stems and short ascenders stretched across wide gaps. But Nata Sans, a sans-serif with wire-thin strokes and open curves, gives that menace somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-eater-gf-nobile: Eater's restful line with modest swings in weight carries a grim, spaced-out snarl across the top. Nobile, a sans-serif with minimal gap between x-height and caps, follows tidily.
gen-eater-gf-nokora: Nokora reads thick and dark, with a wide-open s that never tightens. Under Eater's gently pressed diagonals and wide gaps, the plain sans would carry long paragraphs with a sturdy, friendly texture.
gen-eater-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Eater brings a dark, aggressive look, with crossbars a touch thinner than its stems and short ascenders. But Noto Kufi Arabic, a plain sans with an open gap in the c, is the modern, welcoming counterweight.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills most of its letter height with lowercase and keeps its c wide open. Eater does the snarling, with letterpress-slug thickness and wide gaps, while Noto Sans does the sensible, contemporary talking.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads clean and contemporary, with curve endings kept well apart and a tall, full c, s and z. Eater's pinched curves bring the menace beside it.
